title: Equal Tree Partition
summary: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it can be partitioned into two trees with equal sums by removing exactly one edge from the original tree.
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it can be partitioned into two trees with equal sums by removing exactly one edge from the original tree.
constraints: The tree contains at least one node with integer values.
Remove exactly one parent-child edge so the two resulting component sums are equal.
